about: FX Multitech Limited, based in Ahmedabad, distributes and exports HVAC and industrial refrigeration products such as compressors, controls, drives, heat exchangers and refrigerants, mainly sourced from Danfoss and other global brands. It operates five warehouses (Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Thane, Bangalore, Hyderabad) and, since January 2025, owns 51% of Everestt Chillers Pvt Ltd, which makes industrial chillers. It does not manufacture products itself.

objects.purpose: Repayment/pre-payment of certain borrowings (HSBC working capital limits)
Investment in subsidiary Everestt Chillers Pvt Ltd for purchase of machinery
General corporate purposes (capped at lower of 15% of issue or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Subhash Agarwal (Managing Director) and Selvaraj Rangaswamy (Whole-time Director) together bring over six decades of HVAC and refrigeration industry experience. The four promoters each sell 87,000 shares in the offer for sale.

concentration.note: FY26 consolidated: top-1 customer 10.16%, top-5 32.52%, top-10 42.58% of sales. Top-1 supplier is 74.11% of purchases and top-5 is 86.58%. Himachal Pradesh alone is about 54.83% of FY26 domestic sales (68.54% in FY25).

litigation_note: Only contingent liabilities of Rs 4.23 lakh (Rs 0.04 crore) disclosed in the extracted sections; no litigation amounts available in the provided text.
strengths: Long supplier relationships with global brands such as Danfoss, Refco, Testo and Gomax give access to a broad HVAC and refrigeration range.
Five warehouses across India support a wide distribution network and quick delivery.
Diversified product mix across compressors, controls, drives, heat exchangers and refrigerants reduces dependence on one product.
Revenue grew from Rs 68.52 crore in FY24 to Rs 126.14 crore in FY26, with EBITDA margin rising from 10.15% to 15.35%.
Reported RoCE of about 29% and RoE of 37.63% in FY26 indicate efficient use of capital.
Technical expertise and after-sales support build repeat business with industrial and commercial customers.
Experienced promoter-led management with over six decades of combined industry experience.
Acquisition of 51% in Everestt Chillers adds in-house chiller manufacturing and lifts FY26 chiller sales to Rs 20.13 crore.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on a single supplier
risks.detail: Top-1 supplier accounted for 74.11% of FY26 purchases and top-5 for 86.58%; purchases are on order basis without binding long-term agreements, so any disruption would hit supplies.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow and working-capital strain
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative at about Rs 0.99 crore in FY26 and Rs 1.93 crore in FY25 despite Rs 12.10 crore profit; inventories of Rs 38.26 crore and receivables of Rs 34.64 crore are large against Rs 126.14 crore revenue.

risks.title: High debt and bank dependence
risks.detail: Borrowings were Rs 26.11 crore at March 2026 against net worth of Rs 38.06 crore, mostly working-capital limits from HSBC secured by promoter guarantees and personal property.

risks.title: No long-term contracts with customers
risks.detail: Sales are on purchase orders; top-10 customers contribute 42.58% of FY26 sales and the top customer 10.16%, so loss of key customers could reduce revenue.

risks.title: Receivable collection risk
risks.detail: Credit is extended to customers; trade receivables of about Rs 34.64 crore at March 2026 expose the company to delays or defaults affecting cash flow.

risks.title: Related-party dealings with group concern
risks.detail: Sales to group concern Frascold India Pvt Ltd were Rs 5.74 crore and purchases Rs 3.36 crore in FY26; promoters and relatives also lent to and were paid by the company.

risks.title: Subsidiary capex may be delayed or cost more
risks.detail: Rs 6.26 crore of proceeds is for machinery for Everestt Chillers, with purchase orders not yet placed, so delays or cost overruns could affect use of funds.

risks.title: Past allotment lapses and non-comparable financials
risks.detail: Earlier share allotments had cash receipts and filing errors with the RoC, risking regulatory action; FY24 figures are standalone while FY25-FY26 are consolidated, and part of the issue is an offer for sale by promoters.

notes: RHP: price band, issue size in rupees, P/E and post-issue shares are blank (null). FY26 and FY25 are restated consolidated; FY24 is restated standalone (not strictly comparable). Amounts converted from lakhs to Rs crore. PAT, EBITDA, margins, RoE, RoCE, RoNW, EPS and debt are as reported; PAT is before minority interest (FY26 attributable PAT about Rs 11.80 crore). Debt/equity and current ratio are computed from balance sheet figures. Cash and bank is as read from garbled tables (FY25 and FY24 are cash and cash equivalents only). Operating cash flow FY26 and FY25 reconciled to net change in cash. Net worth excludes minority interest. Reservation percentages are the minimum/maximum limits stated; anchor share not separately stated. No peers listed in RHP. Market maker reservation 1,96,800 shares; net offer 37,03,200 shares.
